Managers ___ expected to lead by example. (a) is (b) are (c) be
The report ___ be filed within seven days. (a) shall (b) might (c) could
You ___ not accept payments from suppliers. (a) must (b) don't have to (c) might
Small gifts ___ to be reported. (a) must (b) don't have (c) shall
Staff are ___ to follow the code. (a) expected (b) expect (c) expecting

100.title: Error correction (editing) — ache e corrija o erro
100.note: Um erro por frase. Corrija e diga por quê.

items.q: Employees must to disclose conflicts of interest.
items.a: Employees must disclose conflicts of interest. (após must → forma base sem 'to')

items.q: Managers are expected lead by example.
items.a: Managers are expected to lead by example. (be expected TO + verbo)

items.q: The report shall to be filed in seven days.
items.a: The report shall be filed in seven days. (após shall → forma base sem 'to')

items.q: You mustn't to accept supplier payments.
items.a: You mustn't accept supplier payments. (após must/mustn't → forma base)

items.q: Staff must completes the training.
items.a: Staff must complete the training. (após must → forma base sem -s)

items.q: Client data must not shared externally.
items.a: Client data must not be shared externally. (passivo: must not be + particípio)

100.title: Fale sobre você / Discuss — obrigações e ética no seu trabalho
100.note: Respostas-modelo de nível B1–B2 que o aluno adapta.

items.q: What rules must every employee follow in your company?
items.a: Every employee must follow the code of conduct and must disclose any conflict of interest.

items.q: What are managers expected to do in your organisation?
items.a: Managers are expected to lead by example and to hold their teams accountable.

items.q: How do you handle a gift from a supplier?
items.a: If a gift is above the set value, it must be reported and signed off by my manager.

items.q: What must never happen with confidential data?
items.a: Confidential data must never be shared externally, and access shall be limited to authorised staff.

items.q: What would you do if you saw a possible breach?
items.a: I would raise a concern through the proper channel, because we are expected to act in good faith.

items.q: How does your company keep high ethical standards?
items.a: We have a clear code of conduct, regular training, and a zero-tolerance policy on conflicts of interest.
